payload.summary: Two live overloads of purge_expired_rag_response_cache, one unbounded
payload.detail: schema.sql:862 defines a zero-arg version whose body is an unbounded delete from rag_response_cache where expires_at <= now(); :6449 defines the bounded (p_limit integer default 1000) version whose whole purpose was to stop a large backlog becoming one long-running delete. Both remain installed. 20260713201542 re-schedules only the bounded call, so nothing invokes the unbounded form today, but it stays executable by service_role and a bare call is now ambiguous against a defaulted overload. FIX: drop the zero-arg overload in a migration plus mirror.
